title: DS in Widescreen
tagline: No black bars, no stretching: DS games drawn wide, with real extra scenery.
what: A build of the melonDS emulator that draws a DS game's top-screen 3D in widescreen on the Thor, at five times the original resolution, with a drawn LCD grid on top for that DS look.
built: Ported WideMelon's widescreen trick into my own melonDS build: 3D drawn 342 pixels wide instead of 256
HD mode: 3D drawn at 5 times the DS resolution, in about 4 ms a frame on the Thor
Wrote an LCD grid shader that stays sharp over HD, with one grid cell per DS pixel
Live switches for widescreen, HD and grid, remembered per game
progress: Only top-screen 3D widens. Games with 3D on the bottom screen gain nothing.

remix.changed: Ported its widescreen method into my melonDS build, then added HD, the LCD grid shader and live switches.

making.problem: A DS game draws its 3D picture for a 4:3 screen. The Thor's top screen is 16:9, so games either sat in black bars or got stretched.
how: The emulator can draw a wider view of the 3D scene, so you see real extra scenery at the sides instead of a stretched picture.
The top screen's 3D is drawn 342 DS pixels wide: at 192 lines that is almost exactly 16:9, the Thor's 1920 by 1080 top panel.
A small launcher passes the settings per game and a live tool changes them while the game runs.
credits: Port, HD mode, LCD grid shader and live switches: me
